services.name: Existing Afu Bike customer, rider, and admin frontend
Existing FastAPI booking and account backend

questions.question: Which frontend language should the landing page use?
questions.rationale: JavaScript matches the existing plain JavaScript frontend implementation.

options.label: JavaScript
options.description: Simpler implementation with no build-time types.

questions.question: Which frontend framework should be used?
questions.rationale: The existing workspace uses plain HTML, CSS, JavaScript modules, and an existing FastAPI backend.

questions.question: Which backend language does the existing service use?
questions.rationale: The existing backend is implemented in Python with FastAPI.

questions.question: Which backend framework does the existing service use?
questions.rationale: The existing custom FastAPI framework must be preserved rather than replaced.

questions.question: Please provide the exact services customers should choose, plus any business name or short introduction to display.
questions.answer: Business name: Afubom ride. No description copy supplied. Service options: ride and delivery.
questions.rationale: The user supplied the exact business name, description, and two service options.

questions.question: Enter the WhatsApp phone number that should receive customer messages. Include the international country code and omit spaces or symbols.
questions.rationale: Personal contact details are required to build working WhatsApp links and must come from the user.

questions.question: Enter the phone number that should open in the call button. State if it is the same as the WhatsApp number.
questions.rationale: A phone number is required for a working click-to-call action.

questions.question: After deployment, should the QR code point to this landing page URL, or do you have a separate public URL already?
questions.recommendedChoice: Generate the QR code from the deployed landing page URL
questions.answer: Generate the QR code from the deployed landing page URL
questions.rationale: The QR code can only be finalized after the public page URL is known.

options.label: Generate the QR code from the deployed landing page URL
options.description: Recommended: one QR code always opens the current public page.

options.label: Use a separate public URL
options.description: Use an existing URL that you provide.

questions.question: Does this app need a database, file storage, queue, cache, or other persistent storage?
questions.rationale: The existing application uses SQLite locally and PostgreSQL for production for account and booking data.

options.label: No datastore required
options.description: The page does not store customer or booking records.

options.label: Blob Storage
options.description: Store or serve uploaded files and media.

questions.question: Should customers sign in to use application API features?
questions.rationale: The existing application has customer, rider, and admin accounts, and account bookings must be retained.

options.label: Yes
options.description: Customers create accounts or sign in.

options.label: No
options.description: No account or sign-in flow is required.
